title: Making a Reservation at a Restaurant
context: Maya 打电话给 Harvest Table 餐厅，向工作人员 Drew 预订周六四人桌。七点半已满，她改订八点的室内安静座位，说明是朋友生日，询问是否可以自带蛋糕，并确认留位时间和停车信息。

dialogue.speaker: Drew
dialogue.en: Good evening, Harvest Table. This is Drew. How can I help you?
dialogue.zh: 晚上好，这里是 Harvest Table。我是 Drew。有什么可以帮您？

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: Hi. I'd like to make a reservation, please.
dialogue.zh: 你好。我想预订一个位子。

dialogue.speaker: Drew
dialogue.en: Of course. For how many people, and which day?

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: A table for four, this Saturday.

dialogue.speaker: Drew
dialogue.en: Saturday is pretty busy. What time were you hoping for?
dialogue.zh: 周六会比较忙。你希望大概几点呢？

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.zh: 如果可以的话，大概七点半。

dialogue.speaker: Drew
dialogue.en: Seven-thirty is fully booked, but I still have a table at eight. Would you like indoor or patio seating?
dialogue.zh: 七点半已经订满了，不过八点还有一张桌子。你想坐室内，还是露台？

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: Eight o'clock indoors, please. It's my friend's birthday, so a quieter table would be great.
dialogue.zh: 请给我八点的室内座位。这是我朋友的生日，所以安静一点的位子会更好。

dialogue.speaker: Drew
dialogue.en: I can note that and put you in a corner booth. May I have your name and a callback number?
dialogue.zh: 我可以记下来，并给你们安排一个靠角落的卡座。可以告诉我你的名字和回拨电话吗？

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: It's Maya Chen, and you can reach me at this number. Can we bring a small cake?
dialogue.zh: 我叫 Maya Chen，用这个号码联系我就行。我们可以自带一个小蛋糕吗？

dialogue.speaker: Drew
dialogue.en: Yes, you're welcome to bring a cake. We hold the table for fifteen minutes, and there's street parking out front.
dialogue.zh: 可以，欢迎你们自带蛋糕。座位会为你们保留十五分钟，门口有路边停车位。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: Perfect. Thank you so much. We'll see you Saturday at eight.
dialogue.zh: 太好了。非常感谢。那我们周六八点见。

expressions.zh: 预订座位。打电话或在餐厅说明来意时常用。
expressions.example: I'd like to make a reservation, please.

expressions.zh: 四个人的桌子。预订时要说明人数和日期。
expressions.example: A table for four, this Saturday.

expressions.zh: 已经订满。某个时间没有空位时常用，后面常接可改订的时间。
expressions.example: Seven-thirty is fully booked, but I still have a table at eight.

expressions.zh: 室内座位还是露台座位。选择用餐位置时常用。patio 指室外或半室外的露台。
expressions.example: Would you like indoor or patio seating?

expressions.zh: 为客人保留座位。餐厅通常会说明最长等待时间。
expressions.example: We hold the table for fifteen minutes, and there's street parking out front.

pronunciation: 练习 reservation 的重音：它落在第三音节，读作 re-ser-VA-tion。注意 patio 读作 /ˈpæti.oʊ/，booth 读作 /buːθ/，以及 fully booked 的连读：FUL-ly booked。

practice.title: Part 1 · Eating out
practice.prompt: Do you often eat at restaurants? Why or why not?
practice.answer: I eat at restaurants once or twice a week, usually on weekends. It's a nice way to catch up with friends, and I don't have to cook. On busy weekdays I prefer to eat at home because it is cheaper and faster.

practice.title: Part 2 · A restaurant reservation
practice.prompt: Describe a time you made a reservation at a restaurant. Say why you booked the table, how you made the reservation, and how it went.
practice.answer: Last month I called a restaurant to book a table for my friend's birthday. I wanted seven-thirty, but that time was fully booked, so I took an indoor table at eight. I asked for a quieter corner booth and brought a small cake. The dinner went really well, and my friend was happy. 这是入门短答，请补充个人经历并扩展到接近两分钟。

practice.title: Part 3 · Reservations and dining
practice.prompt: Why do some people prefer to reserve a table instead of walking in?
practice.answer: Reserving a table can save time, especially on weekends when popular restaurants get busy. People may also want a special seat, such as a quiet booth for a birthday. Some diners still walk in if they are flexible or if the restaurant usually has empty tables.

practice.title: 跟读与口头练习
practice.prompt: 先听完整对话，再逐句跟读。最后练习打电话订位：说明人数和日期、想要的时间、室内还是露台，以及有没有特殊安排。
practice.answer: 用 3–4 句说明你会怎么预订餐厅：人数和日期、时间、座位偏好，以及是否需要保留座位或自带蛋糕。
